claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_rider (class feature family)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Superior Hunter's Prey fires automatically on a game event (dealing damage to a marked creature). It is not an 'activation' — there is no action/bonus action cost, no rest-based resource, and no use_count that resets on rest. The only ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which does not model passively-triggered per-turn riders.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Once per turn when you deal damage to a creature marked by your Hunter's Mark, you can also deal that spell's extra damage...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: on_damage_window (ClassFeatureTrigger)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The trigger is 'when you deal damage to a creature marked by Hunter's Mark' — a damage event conditioned on a spell mark being present on the target. This is neither an on_hit_window (which is attack-roll-scoped) nor any existing ClassFeature trigger. It requires a new trigger kind that checks 'target carries mark from named unit'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: when you deal damage to a creature marked by your Hunter's Mark

claude_proposed_widenings.name: once_per_turn (ClassFeature reset cadence or usage limit)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The usage limit is 'once per turn', which has no analog in RestResetCadence (all variants reset on short or long rest). MasteryUsageLimit.once_per_turn exists but is typed only for MasteryMechanics; ClassFeatureMechanics has no such variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Once per turn when you deal damage...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: damage_cross_ref (ClassFeatureEffect or PassiveRiderEffect)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The damage amount is not a standalone DiceExpr — it is 'that spell's extra damage', a reference to Hunter's Mark's DamageOnHitOperation amount. No effect type in ClassFeatureEffect or anywhere else in the surface can represent a damage amount drawn from another unit's authored expression by reference.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can also deal that spell's extra damage to a different creature

claude_proposed_widenings.name: secondary_creature_within_range (target selection for passive rider effect)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The damage is applied to a 'different creature that you can see within 30 feet of the first creature' — a secondary target relative to the primary (marked) target. SecondaryTargetSelection exists only in MasteryMechanics (GrantWeaponAttackRider), not in any class feature effect.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: to a different creature that you can see within 30 feet of the first creature
